title: Plug-and-play Smart Contract API: a game-changing platform to deploy open-source contracts instantly

ms.promise:
Develop and implement the following contracts
・Single Asset Staking Contracts: These contracts enable users to collectively stake their digital assets and fairly distribute rewards among participants.
・Linear Vesting Contracts: Our secure linear vesting contracts offer customization options, providing a reliable mechanism for releasing assets gradually over a specified timeframe.
・Direct Offer: Our contract facilitates peer-to-peer trading of assets through the Direct Offer feature
ms.report:
We have developed and implement the following contracts
・Single Asset Staking Contracts: These contracts enable users to collectively stake their digital assets and fairly distribute rewards among participants.
・Linear Vesting Contracts: Our secure linear vesting contracts offer customization options, providing a reliable mechanism for releasing assets gradually over a specified timeframe.
・Direct Offer: Our contract facilitates peer-to-peer trading of assets through the Direct Offer feature (merged commit with the documentation as it was moved just after we submitted PoA :)

All contracts can be found on our github: 
https://github.com/Anastasia-Labs/plug-n-play-contracts
